d: Military training orbital stations and asteroid command bunkers in Orson Scott Card’s Enderverse.

433-eros.x: Asteroid 433 Eros converted into the subterranean International Fleet Command School where Ender conducts the decisive simulation campaigns.

moon.x: High lunar orbit sector hosting the International Fleet Battle School where gifted children compete in zero-gravity battle rooms.

b.s: Classic Hugo and Nebula award-winning novel following tactical prodigy Ender Wiggin in humanity’s desperate defense against the insectoid Formics.
